Question: There exists a unique strictly increasing sequence of nonnegative integers \(a_1<a_2<\cdots<a_k\) such that \[\frac{2^{289}+1}{2^{17}+1}=2^{a_1}+2^{a_2}+\cdots+2^{a_k}.\] What is \(k?\)
